# Introduction

```{r}
# Spatial Libraries
library(arrow)
library(geoarrow)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)

# General Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
library(lubridate)
library(glue)
library(gt)

# ggplot2 theming
theme_set(theme_classic())
theme_update(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
             plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
             strip.background = element_blank(),
             strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
             axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, vjust = 1, hjust=1))
```

This doc includes the count of each neighborhood type by city, and additionally provides spatial plots of the neighborhood types across each city. Furthermore, RRs at the 99th temperature percentile (P99) are shown compared to both the MMT and P75.

# Analysis Including Pop Density

First we show the results including the percent greenspace, percent educated, and population density variables. In the next section we simplify the results by discarding the population density variable.

## Spatial Plots

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Read in neighborhood level variables."

# Load data ---------------------------------------------------------------
list_df <- readRDS(here("1-data", "list_city_df.rds"))
city_names <- names(list_df)
var_names <- c(pct_green = "Percent Greenspace",
               pct_educated = "Percent Educated",
               pop_density = "Population Density")

list_df <- list_df |> 
  map(\(df0) {
    # Define city-specific median points
    med_pct_green    <- median(df0$pct_green)
    med_pct_educated <- median(df0$pct_educated)
    med_pop_density  <- median(df0$pop_density)
    
    # Add categorical dummy variables
    df0 <- df0 |> 
      mutate(pct_green_low    = ifelse(pct_green    <= med_pct_green,    1, 0),
             pct_green_high   = ifelse(pct_green    >  med_pct_green,    1, 0),
             pct_educated_low = ifelse(pct_educated <= med_pct_educated, 1, 0),
             pct_educated_high= ifelse(pct_educated >  med_pct_educated, 1, 0),
             pop_density_low  = ifelse(pop_density  <= med_pop_density,  1, 0),
             pop_density_high = ifelse(pop_density  >  med_pop_density,  1, 0))
  })
```


```{r}
#| code-summary: "Read in spatial boundaries."
# Pennsylvania ------------------------------------------------------------
phl_sf <- "//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/CCUH/ccuh-server/freeze//schema_ccuh_phl_metro_nbhd/schema_ccuh_phl_metro_nbhd__nad83.parquet" %>%
  arrow::open_dataset() %>% 
  sf::st_as_sf()

# SALURBAL Cities ---------------------------------------------------------

# Connect to API
df_salurbal_nbhd <- "//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/CCUH/ccuh-server/freeze/salurbal_boundaries__v1/salurbal_boundaries_v1.parquet" %>% 
  arrow::open_dataset() |> 
  sf::st_as_sf()

# Create city specific sf object
rio_sf <- df_salurbal_nbhd |> filter(str_detect(geoid, "102190"), geo == "l2_5") |> mutate(nbhd_geoid = geoid, city_name = "Rio de Janiero")
sao_sf <- df_salurbal_nbhd |> filter(str_detect(geoid, "102248"), geo == "l2_5") |> mutate(nbhd_geoid = geoid, city_name = "Sao Paulo")
gua_sf <- df_salurbal_nbhd |> filter(str_detect(geoid, "203102"), geo == "l2")   |> mutate(nbhd_geoid = geoid, city_name = "Guatemala City")
pan_sf <- df_salurbal_nbhd |> filter(str_detect(geoid, "206101"), geo == "l2")   |> mutate(nbhd_geoid = geoid, city_name = "Panama City")

# Bind into list
list_sf <- list(gua_sf, pan_sf, phl_sf, rio_sf, sao_sf)
```

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Create spatial plots."
# Specify neighborhood types
var_levels <- c(
  model_1 = "Low Green, Edu, Pop Dens",
  model_2 = "Low Green, Edu/High Pop Dens",
  model_3 = "Low Green, Pop Dens/High Edu",
  model_4 = "Low Green/High Edu, Pop Dens",
  model_5 = "High Green/Low Edu, Pop Dens",
  model_6 = "High Green, Pop Dens/Low Edu",
  model_7 = "High Green, Edu/Low Pop Dens",
  model_8 = "High Green, Edu, Pop Dens"
)

# Classify each neighborhood
df_categories <- list_df |> 
  map(\(df_city) {
    df_city |> 
      summarize(across(everything(), first), .by = nbhd_geoid) |> 
      mutate(nbhd_type = case_when(
        pct_green_low == 1 & pct_educated_low == 1 & pop_density_low == 1 ~ var_levels[1],
        pct_green_low == 1 & pct_educated_low == 1 & pop_density_low == 0 ~ var_levels[2],
        pct_green_low == 1 & pct_educated_low == 0 & pop_density_low == 1 ~ var_levels[3],
        pct_green_low == 1 & pct_educated_low == 0 & pop_density_low == 0 ~ var_levels[4],
        pct_green_low == 0 & pct_educated_low == 1 & pop_density_low == 1 ~ var_levels[5],
        pct_green_low == 0 & pct_educated_low == 1 & pop_density_low == 0 ~ var_levels[6],
        pct_green_low == 0 & pct_educated_low == 0 & pop_density_low == 1 ~ var_levels[7],
        pct_green_low == 0 & pct_educated_low == 0 & pop_density_low == 0 ~ var_levels[8],
        .default = NA
      ) |> factor(levels = var_levels))
  })

# Create Spatial plots of each neighborhood
list_spatial_plots <- 
  pmap(list(name = city_names,
            sf   = list_sf,
            df   = df_categories), 
       \(name, sf, df) {
         sf |> 
           left_join(df, by = "nbhd_geoid") |> 
           ggplot(aes(fill = nbhd_type)) +
           geom_sf() +
           scale_fill_brewer(type = "qual", drop = FALSE) +
           labs(title = name, fill = "Neiborhood\nType")
       })
```

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Show spatial plots."

list_spatial_plots[[1]]
list_spatial_plots[[2]]
list_spatial_plots[[3]]
list_spatial_plots[[4]]
list_spatial_plots[[5]]
```

```{r}
RR_ratio_est <- function(fit1, fit2, se1, se2) {
  glue("{RR} ({lower}, {upper})",
       RR = round(exp(fit1 - fit2), 3),
       lower = round(exp(fit1 - fit2 - qnorm(.975)*sqrt(se1^2 + se2^2)), 3),
       upper = round(exp(fit1 - fit2 + qnorm(.975)*sqrt(se1^2 + se2^2)), 3))
}

readRDS("p99_RR_by_city_multi_interaction_RR_diffs2.rds")
```

}

# Correlation Plots

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Create correlation plots."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8

# Create plots
list_cor_plots <-
  pmap(list(name = city_names,
            df = list_df),
       \(name, df) {
         map2(c("pct_green",   "pct_green",    "pct_educated"), 
              c("pop_density", "pct_educated", "pop_density"),
              \(var1, var2) {
                df |>
                  summarize(across(everything(), first), .by = c(nbhd_geoid)) |>
                  ggplot(aes(.data[[var1]], .data[[var2]])) +
                  geom_point() +
                  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
                  ggpubr::stat_cor(label.x = 80, aes(label = after_stat(r.label))) +
                  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
                  labs(title = name, x = var_names[[var1]], y = var_names[[var2]])
              }) |> set_names(c("cor1", "cor2", "cor3"))
  })



# Display pct_green and pop_density
wrap_plots(map(list_cor_plots, \(x) x$cor1), ncol = 2)

# Display pct_green and pct_educated
wrap_plots(map(list_cor_plots, \(x) x$cor2), ncol = 2)

# Display pop_desnity and pct_educated
wrap_plots(map(list_cor_plots, \(x) x$cor3), ncol = 2)

```
